lsc-smart-indoor.summary: Fixed-view indoor camera with a native Fullhan video backend and manual infrared controls.
lsc-smart-indoor.identification: Check the chip marking FH8626V100 and the MIS2006 sensor revision. The product name or enclosure alone is not enough to choose firmware.
lsc-smart-indoor.backend_note: Own native media backend. The Tuya application is excluded from the built runtime. Original kernel, hardware modules and selected runtime libraries are retained.
lsc-smart-indoor.image_alt: LSC Smart Connect Smart Indoor IP Camera retail packaging, showing the fixed camera and 1080p HD label

lsc-smart-rotatable.summary: Motorised indoor camera with pan and tilt, touch-and-hold control, audio and infrared night vision.
lsc-smart-rotatable.identification: The verified chip is marked ANYKA AK3918EN080 V300S. This profile uses the AK39EV330 backend with the MIS2006 sensor. Other revisions need their own investigation.
lsc-smart-rotatable.backend_note: Interim SDK-host backend: original application main is blocked, but proprietary vendor SDK code remains for media support. The updater replaces APP only.
lsc-smart-rotatable.image_alt: LSC Smart Connect Smart Rotatable Camera retail packaging, showing the pan-and-tilt camera and 1080p HD label
